read.en: Bloom Energy fell 8.6% on Oct 30 to $203.17, trading between $194.15 and $215.45, after a 2.5% slip on Oct 29. It is below the falling 5-day ($215.2), 10-day ($217.4), 30-day ($253.4) and 100-day ($245.6) averages and the rising 200-day ($221.3). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 8, below zero, histogram ticking wider again; Parabolic SAR is still bullish since Oct 28 ($190.69), and RSI is 39.
read.zh: Bloom Energy 10月30日下跌 8.6%，收于 $203.17，盘中区间 $194.15–215.45；此前 10月29日小跌 2.5%。股价位于下行的 5 日（$215.2）、10 日（$217.4）、30 日（$253.4）和 100 日均线（$245.6）以及上行的 200 日均线（$221.3）下方。MACD 自 10月8日起位于信号线下方且在零轴之下，柱状图再度小幅扩大；抛物线 SAR 自 10月28日起仍看多（$190.69），RSI 为 39。

read.en: The drop broke the $220.6–224.2 (10 and 200-day, Oct 27 high) and $211.3–212.3 supports, now resistance; the $197.5 Sep 1 low held. Resistance is $211.3–215.5 (Oct 27 low, 5-day, Oct 30 high), then $217.4–221.3 (10 and 200-day) and $231.7–233.6. Support is $194.2–197.5, then $189–190.7 (Oct 23 low, SAR) and $185.9 (Aug 24 low). A close above $215.5 would target $217–221; below $189, $186.
